# Config families

Paths are relative to the repository root. Read a folder when its subject comes up; its _template.yaml says what one entry holds. A family only this instance has is named in identity/agent/INSTANCE.md.

| Family | Read it when | Skill · guide |
|---|---|---|
| `identity/accounts/` | a cloud tenant, subscription or vault reference; read it before ANY cloud operation (az, wrangler, gcloud, gh api, provider REST) instead of reconstructing tenant, subscription or vault from memory; no raw secret in YAML, reference URIs only | /secrets · `docs/cloud-accounts.md` · `rules/secret-placement.md` |
| `identity/agent/` | this orchestrator's own name, role and voice; IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md and INSTANCE.md load with AGENTS.md | `identity/agent/README.md` |
| `identity/contracts/` | a recurring obligation: utility, telco, insurance, SaaS |  |
| `identity/designs/` | a brand: colours, type and shapes a generated visual uses; DESIGN.md is the default and the index to the others; never hand-pick a brand colour, ask `scripts/designs.py resolve` and add a missing token to the design that owns it | `DESIGN.md` |
| `identity/mail-footers/` | drafting a mail: how it is signed | /mail-draft · `docs/mail-draft.md` |
| `identity/mandants/` | who RECEIVES an outgoing message (a recipient group, not an identity the user holds); on when mandants.enabled | /mandants · `docs/mandants.md` |
| `identity/personas/` | an identity the user HOLDS: signature, tax data, filing paths; loaded when a skill or routing order names it via persona_ref | `docs/personas.md` |
| `identity/vehicles/` | a vehicle the user owns or leases: plate, VIN, the persona that bears it |  |
| `infra/a2a-peers/` | an A2A agent this Bridge may ask: card, auth, token reference | /a2a |
| `infra/backups/` | what is backed up where, and whether it is fresh; activated by topology.yaml existing; CORE ships the data model, no executor, and only the backup executor writes _state.yaml | `infra/backups/README.md` |
| `infra/channels/` | an outbound transport: mail, chat, bot, digest; scheduled sends go to /schedule | /channel · `docs/channels.md` |
| `infra/instances/` | another Bridge this one should know about | `docs/multi-instance.md` |
| `infra/object-stores/` | where content that is not configuration lives: recordings, documents, exports | /object-store · `docs/object-store.md` |
| `infra/remotes/` | a machine: ssh, wake, services, "which PC"; remote means a machine here, never `git remote`, so check this folder before asking "which PC?"; capability `arm` marks the always-on machine | /remote · `docs/remotes.md` · `docs/always-on-machine.md` |
| `infra/secret-stores/` | where a secret lives, who reaches it, and which kind belongs in it | /secrets · `docs/secrets.md` |
| `infra/transcriptions/` | recording to transcript topology | `docs/transcription-worker.md` |
| `infra/utilities/` | a supply contract at a location: power, gas, water, heat |  |
| `workflow/ai-services/` | which AI model a service or worker uses (default Claude) | `docs/ai-services.md` |
| `workflow/briefings/` | what a briefing shows, from which trackers | /briefing · `docs/briefings.md` |
| `workflow/calendars/` | a scheduled outbound action: what, to whom, when; on when calendar.enabled | /calendar · `docs/calendar.md` |
| `workflow/contexts/` | where a piece of work gets documented |  |
| `workflow/cost-centers/` | a project's costs across accounts: the cost card's Project filter | `docs/cloud-costs.md` |
| `workflow/mail-profiles/` | drafting a mail: the occasion | /mail-draft · `docs/mail-draft.md` |
| `workflow/meetings/` | a recurring meeting series |  |
| `workflow/projects/` | a board's field values and state map, before ANY tracker call; never hardcode a field value | /github-projects-manager |
| `workflow/workloads/` | one declared run on one machine; deliberately no status: field, state comes from the live service manager | /workload · `docs/workloads.md` |
| `workflow/workspaces/` | a named binding of repos + config overlays | /workspace · `docs/workspaces.md` |

Own lifecycle: `rules/` `protocols/standing-orders/` `skills/` `trackers/` `themes/` `.claude/agents/` `mods/` `work/` `docs/`
